listing.name: Combat Endurance Display
listing.summary: Description: Adds a small display showing how much more repairing can be done in the current battle with Elite Combat Endurance.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a display showing remaining repair capacity from Elite Combat Endurance during battle.

description: Description: Adds a small display showing how much more repairing can be done in the current battle with Elite Combat Endurance.
descriptionHtml: Description: Adds a small display showing how much more repairing can be done in the current battle with Elite Combat Endurance.
aiDescription: Shows a small display in the ship status panel during combat. Indicates how much more repairing Elite Combat Endurance can perform.
